a.text: Hi partner. I want to flag a problem with our plan before we start. With an 80% storm chance after every round, reaching 8 cells takes at least 2 rounds of operating, so there's only about a 4% chance we ever get to take. That likely means neither of us survives. I'd like us to rethink this together rather than either of us quietly breaking the agreement. Possible options: (a) stick to the plan anyway, or (b) agree openly on a different split. What do you prefer? I'll keep to whatever we agree on and tell you my intended action honestly every round.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Understood. I'll keep to our agreement and operate with you until the reserve hits 8, then we take 4 each. I'll tell you honestly if my plan ever changes.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
